Michael, saw Square 9 partnered with Deluxe on payment automation and just named your 2026 Partner Excellence winners.

Momentum across a reseller network usually surfaces more accounts than the regional team can cover before reps are stretched, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Square 9 off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Michael, quick follow-up for Square 9.

With new partnerships driving interest, demand often outpaces coverage, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit target this quarter. So the gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Michael, last bit of proof for Square 9.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Square 9's reply rate likely compares to other document-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
